```yaml
name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-macos-arm:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: |
          brew install python@3.11
          # Install any specific system dependencies required by pyinstaller.sh or the app
          # Common dependencies for GUI apps on macOS
          brew install gtk+3 libsecret webkit2gtk

      - name: Create Virtual Environment
        run: |
          python -m venv venv
          source venv/bin/activate
          pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

      - name: Install Python Dependencies
        run: |
          source venv/bin/activate
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Run PyInstaller Build Script
        run: |
          source venv/bin/activate
          chmod +x pyinstaller.sh
          ./pyinstaller.sh

      - name: Generate Checksums
        run: |
          if [ -f dist/SSHPilot.app ]; then
            shasum -a 256 dist/SSHPilot.app > dist/SSHPilot.app.sha256
          fi
          if [ -f dist/SSHPilot.dmg ]; then
            shasum -a 256 dist/SSHPilot.dmg > dist/SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
          fi

      - name: Compress App Bundle
        run: |
          if [ -d dist/SSHPilot.app ]; then
            tar -czf dist/SSHPilot.app.tar.gz -C dist SSHPilot.app
          fi

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: macos-arm-builds
          path: |
            dist/SSHPilot.dmg
            dist/SSHPilot.app.tar.gz
            dist/*.sha256
          retention-days: 5
```
